title: primitive.json
description: The effect primitive registry (contracts.md §2.6 and §3). §3 is normative and this file must match it. The set is closed: an effect naming a primitive absent from here is a hard load failure, which is also what keeps content from inventing a portal-stability primitive (contracts.md §1.6).

floor.$comment: Optional, same shape as `cap` but a lower bound instead of an upper one. Exists so a Perdo `remove` (or a draining `transform`) can be stopped before it drives a world-scale rate to zero or negative -- an uncapped-below multiplier is a division hazard downstream and an unrecoverable state for the mage holding it. contracts.md §3 lists which primitives carry one, and its Floor column is normative.
